title: System Reference: Refund of Crestline Companion Taxes and Fees on Cancellation
content:
When a companion booking made on Crestline Companion Certificates and Passes is cancelled, the taxes and fees charged for it are refunded to the holder by the companion desk in one refund entry that names that taxes-and-fees charge.

The taxes-and-fees refund of a cancelled booking is not worked out until the certificate's ledger carries the refund of that booking's companion fare. For a booking that carried a Hawaii surcharge, the taxes-and-fees refund is not worked out until the certificate's ledger also carries the refund of that surcharge.

Put as states of the record: while the trip and charge history of the certificate or pass does not yet show the refund of that booking's companion fare — and, for a booking that carried a Hawaii surcharge, the refund of that surcharge as well — the taxes-and-fees refund of the booking is not worked out.

## Capability

`refund_companion_taxes_and_fees_22c15e93` records one refund of component taxes and fees, dated the current business date, on the trip and charge history of one certificate or pass. The refund names the taxes-and-fees charge it refunds and carries that charge's companion ticket number; the holder's companion charges fall by the amount refunded and the holder sees the refund on the certificate or pass.

## How it is invoked

Agent-side: the agent unlocks `refund_companion_taxes_and_fees_22c15e93`, then calls it.

## Parameters

| Name | What it is | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `companion_id` | Reference number of the companion certificate or pass record the refund is recorded on, as returned by the companion certificate and pass lookup | identifier |
| `reversed_entry_id` | Reference number of the taxes-and-fees charge entry being refunded, as returned by the companion trip and charge history lookup | identifier |
| `amount` | The taxes-and-fees amount refunded | USD, decimal rounded to 2 decimal places (cents), rounding half up; never negative |

## Return

On success a receipt with `refund_entry_id`, `companion_id`, `refunded_charge_entry_id`, `charge_component` (always `taxes_and_fees`), `amount_usd` (2 decimal places), `entry_date` (YYYY-MM-DD, today's business date) and `status` (`refund_recorded` when the refund is on file). No error receipt is defined.
